introHtml: Rectangular hand sanitizers offer a sleek, portable shape that fits easily into pockets, bags, or card slots—ideal for trade shows, corporate events, and employee wellness kits. Unlike round or irregular bottles, the flat profile allows for full-color label printing on a larger surface area, maximizing brand visibility. Choose from gel packets, spray bottles, or credit card-style designs to match your promotion perfectly.
